decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical current directory structure and flags.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The file is included by selected DOS directory modules, BIOS initialization sources and COMMAND comequ.asm.
Previously compared DIR2 and DIRCALL contributions match all 1413 and 521 bytes respectively at their target MSDOS.SYS offsets (reviews 054 and 055).
Prior PATH comparison has five differing bytes, all in marked address fields, among 366 bytes (review 098).
limitations: These comparisons support definitions exercised in selected modules; they do not establish every field use or final linked addresses. Complete core file identity remains unverified.
